parameters.name: AutoCreateProxy
parameters.description: Indicates whether automatic creation of a database proxy is enabled. Valid values:

parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

- **true**: Automatic payment is enabled. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
- **false**: Only an order is generated, and no payment is made.


> Default value: true. If your payment method has an insufficient balance, you can set AutoPay to false. In this case, an unpaid order is generated. You can log on to the ApsaraDB RDS console to complete the payment.
>

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. This parameter takes effect only when you create a subscription instance. Valid values:
* **true**: Enabled.
* **false**: Not enabled.

> * If you purchase the instance on a monthly basis, the auto-renewal cycle is one month.
> * If you purchase the instance on a yearly basis, the auto-renewal cycle is one year.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use coupons. Valid values:

parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the I/O burst feature for a [premium performance disk](~~2340501~~) cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The instance edition. Valid values:

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: CustomExtraInfo
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The instance type. For more information, see [Read-only instance types](~~145759~~). We recommend that the specifications of the read-only instance be equal to or higher than those of the primary instance. Otherwise, the read-only instance may experience high latency and heavy load.

parameters.name: DBInstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the primary instance. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage
parameters.description: Instance storage capacity. Instance storage capacity of the read-only instance must be greater than or equal to that of the primary instance. For more information, see the **Storage capacity** column in [Read-only instance types](~~145759~~). The value is incremented in units of 5 GB. Unit: GB.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:
* **local_ssd**: Premium Local SSDs
* **cloud_ssd**: standard SSDs
* **cloud_essd**: PL1 ESSDs
* **cloud_essd2**: PL2 ESSDs
* **cloud_essd3**: PL3 ESSDs
* **general_essd**: Premium ESSDs


> * If the primary ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance uses Premium Local SSDs, you can set this parameter only to **local_ssd**. If the primary ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance uses cloud disks, you can set this parameter only to a cloud disk storage type.
> * SQL Server supports only cloud disk storage types.

parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId
parameters.description: The dedicated cluster ID. This parameter is required when you create a read-only instance in a dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the release protection feature for the instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version. The version must be the same as that of the primary instance.

parameters.name: GdnInstanceName
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceNetworkType
parameters.description: The network type of the read-only instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: InstructionSetArch
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: IoAccelerationEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE)](~~2527067~~) feature for a premium performance disk cloud disk. Valid values:

parameters.name: IsAnalyticReadOnlyIns
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to create a DuckDB-based analytical instance. Valid values:

- **true**: enabled.
- **false**: disabled.

> Currently, only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL support the creation of DuckDB-based analytical instances.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values:
* **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
* **Prepaid**: subscription.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: Specifies whether the subscription instance is billed on a yearly or monthly basis. Valid values:

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port that is initialized when you create a read-only instance for an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL primary instance.

parameters.name: PrivateIpAddress
parameters.description: Settings for the internal network IP address of the read-only instance. The IP address must be within the address range of the specified vSwitch. The system automatically allocates an internal network IP address based on the values of **VPCId** and **VSwitchId** by default.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. The region of the read-only instance must be the same as that of the primary instance. You can call DescribeRegions to query the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: TargetDedicatedHostIdForMaster
parameters.description: The host ID of the primary instance. This parameter is required when you create a read-only instance in a dedicated cluster.

parameters.name: TddlBizType
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: TddlRegionConfig
parameters.description: A reserved parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Valid values:
* If **Period** is set to **Year**, **UsedTime** can be set to **1** to **5**.
* If **Period** is set to **Month**, **UsedTime** can be set to **1** to **9**.

> This parameter is required if **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: The VPC ID of the read-only instance. This parameter is required when **InstanceNetworkType** is set to empty or **VPC**.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID of the read-only instance. This parameter is required when **InstanceNetworkType** is set to empty or **VPC**.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query available zones.

- To deploy the instance in a single zone, specify one zone ID, such as `cn-hangzhou-b`.
- To deploy the instance across multiple zones, specify multiple zone IDs separated by colons (:), such as `cn-hangzhou-b:cn-hangzhou-c`.
- The number of specified zones must be less than or equal to the number of nodes in the read-only instance. A Basic Edition read-only instance contains only 1 node. A high-availability series read-only instance contains 2 nodes (1 primary node and 1 secondary node).
